name: Lorian Dace
source_profile:
Lorian Dace (LE) — Ranger-Captain

Sir Lorian is a polished and calculating former customs officer who rose to prominence through his ability to secure Bellamy's commercial interests. He considers the prosperity of Westbridge inseparable from the authority of its marquis and is willing to employ questionable methods to protect both. Though he maintains an outward appearance of impeccable professionalism, Lorian has little hesitation in using intimidation, selective enforcement, or carefully manufactured legal pretexts to achieve his objectives.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 21 (source excerpt; may be partial)
